new_questions.title: Highest mid-career alumni salary (Payscale)
new_questions.prompt: Name the US colleges whose alumni report the highest median mid-career salaries in Payscale's College Salary Report.
new_questions.disclaimer: Median mid-career pay from Payscale's self-reported alumni salary survey; bachelor's-only graduates 10+ years out. Salaries in USD.
new_questions.trivia: Harvey Mudd — a small STEM-focused liberal arts college in Claremont — has led or shared the top of Payscale's list for over a decade, driven by its engineering-only bachelor's cohort.

new_questions.title: Highest 6-year graduation rate
new_questions.prompt: Name the US universities with the highest six-year undergraduate graduation rates.
new_questions.disclaimer: IPEDS six-year graduation rate for the most recent entering full-time first-time bachelor's cohort.
new_questions.trivia: Every school at the top of this list clusters between 95% and 98%, with the Ivies and small-cohort peers essentially tied — a floor set less by academics than by attrition-avoidance.
new_questions.source_name: US Department of Education — IPEDS / College Scorecard

new_questions.title: Most NCAA D1 men's lacrosse titles
new_questions.prompt: Name the schools with the most NCAA Division I Men's Lacrosse Championships.
new_questions.disclaimer: NCAA D1 Men's Lacrosse Championship era (1971-present). Pre-NCAA claimed national titles are not counted.
new_questions.trivia: Syracuse's 1990 title was later vacated by the NCAA; the school still claims it, and most historical rankings include it.

new_questions.title: Most NCAA D1 men's hockey titles (in-pool)
new_questions.prompt: Name the schools (from this game's college pool) with the most NCAA Division I Men's Ice Hockey Championships.
new_questions.disclaimer: NCAA D1 Men's Ice Hockey Championship era (1948-present). Denver (10) and North Dakota (8) lead all-time overall but Denver is not in this game's college pool. Rankings shown reflect in-pool order.
new_questions.trivia: Michigan won the first NCAA hockey championship in 1948; the Wolverines and North Dakota have combined for more than half of all Big Ten / WCHA-era titles.
new_questions.source_name: NCAA — Men's Ice Hockey Championship History

new_questions.title: Highest percentage of Pell Grant recipients
new_questions.prompt: Name the US colleges (within the game's answer pool) with the highest share of undergraduates receiving federal Pell Grants.
new_questions.disclaimer: IPEDS share of full-time first-time undergraduates receiving Pell Grants. Pell eligibility is a federal proxy for lower-income enrollment.
new_questions.trivia: HBCUs routinely lead Pell share among selective institutions in the U.S., reflecting decades of access-focused missions.
new_questions.source_name: US Department of Education — IPEDS / College Scorecard

new_questions.title: Highest percentage of international students
new_questions.prompt: Name the US universities with the highest share of international students in their undergraduate enrollment.
new_questions.disclaimer: IPEDS non-resident alien share of total undergraduate enrollment; excludes graduate-only programs.
new_questions.trivia: Rochester, Carnegie Mellon, and NYU consistently top international-enrollment share lists among selective private universities.

new_questions.title: Most NCAA D1 women's soccer titles (in-pool)
new_questions.prompt: Name the schools (from this game's college pool) with the most NCAA Division I Women's Soccer Championships.
new_questions.disclaimer: NCAA D1 Women's Soccer Championship era (1982-present). Portland (2), Santa Clara (1), and George Mason (1) also have titles but are outside this game's college pool. Rankings shown reflect in-pool order.
new_questions.trivia: North Carolina's dynasty under Anson Dorrance defined the sport's early NCAA era, with the Tar Heels winning 21 of the first 23 titles.

new_questions.title: Lowest average student loan debt at graduation
new_questions.prompt: Name the US colleges whose graduates leave with the lowest average federal student-loan debt.
new_questions.disclaimer: US Department of Education College Scorecard median federal loan debt among bachelor's completers. Excludes private/parent loans. Rank 1 = smallest debt.
new_questions.trivia: Princeton was the first US university to eliminate loans from its financial-aid packages entirely (2001) — replacing them with grants — which is why its median debt is effectively zero for aided students.
new_questions.source_name: US Department of Education — College Scorecard
